findings.title: Concurrent test does not wait for the reader thread and can pass vacuously or hang
findings.body: The test starts a non-daemon reader thread, deletes the groups, sets deletedAll, and immediately asserts that caughtExceptions is empty. It never joins the thread or waits for at least one read to occur during deletion, so the assertion can run before the reader performs any request or after it has already stopped, missing the race the test is meant to catch. If a delete call throws before deletedAll.set(true), the reader loop may also run indefinitely. Use a latch/join, ensure reads overlap with deletes, and stop the thread in a finally block.

findings.title: Other subgroup methods still dereference modelSupplier without a null check
findings.body: The fix in getSubGroupsCount acknowledges that modelSupplier.get() can return null when the group has been deleted concurrently. However, getSubGroupsStream(String, Integer, Integer) at line 256, getSubGroupsStream(Integer, Integer) at line 262, and getSubGroupsStream(String, Boolean, Integer, Integer) at line 268 still call modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...) directly. If the underlying group no longer exists, modelSupplier.get() can be null and these methods will still throw NullPointerException, leaving the same concurrency bug for subgroup search/pagination paths.
